title: After registration the login page opens and the user is logged out
preconditions: Browser is logged out. The registration page is open. Use a new email, for example reconqa-fu101@example.test.
step: Enter the new email in «Email». Enter Reconqa#2026 in «Password» and in «Repeat Password».
expected: No error message should be shown under the three fields.

step: Choose «Name of your favorite pet?» in «Security Question» and enter Rex in «Answer».

expected: The login page should open, not the product list. A toast «Registration completed successfully. You can now log in.» should be shown.

step: Open the Account menu in the top bar.
expected: The menu should offer «Login», which shows the user is not logged in.

title: Registering with an email that already has an account is rejected
preconditions: Browser is logged out. Register reconqa-fu102@example.test first with valid data (password Reconqa#2026, any security question and answer). Then open the registration page again.
step: Enter reconqa-fu102@example.test in «Email». Enter Reconqa#2026 in «Password» and in «Repeat Password».
expected: No error message should be shown under the three fields.

step: Choose «Name of your favorite pet?» in «Security Question» and enter Rex in «Answer».

expected: An alert banner «Email must be unique» should be shown under the «User Registration» heading. The account should not be created a second time.

step: Look at the area under the «Email» field.
expected: No text "This email is already registered." should be shown under the field.

title: Password advice switch shows the strength bar and checklist
preconditions: Browser is logged out. The registration page is open.

step: Turn on the switch «Show password advice».
expected: A strength bar and a checklist should be shown.

The checklist should contain exactly these items: «contains at least one lower character», «contains at least one upper character», «contains at least one digit», «contains at least one special character», «contains at least 8 characters».

title: Security question field warns that it cannot be changed later
preconditions: Browser is logged out. The registration page is open.
step: Look at the «Security Question» field without choosing an option.
expected: The hint «This cannot be changed later!» should be shown for the field.

step: Choose «Name of your favorite pet?» in «Security Question».
expected: The hint «This cannot be changed later!» should still be shown.

title: Password counter after typing 41 characters
preconditions: Browser is logged out. The registration page is open.
step: Type 41 characters (for example the letter a repeated 41 times) in «Password».
expected: The counter under the field should show «40/20».

step: Read the hint under the field.
expected: The hint «Password must be 5-40 characters long.» should be shown.
